prompt: Name the three layers of this semantic search architecture, in order from input to output. Comma-separated.
Is this architecture vector/embedding-based semantic search, or something else? One short sentence.
Name two situations where this tagging-based architecture is NOT a good fit and another approach would be better. Brief.
notes: Not for free-text/open-ended; not without curated taxonomy

prompt: What HTTP path does the TagHandler register on (the URL endpoint for tagging requests)? Just the path.
Name the relation types (TagTypes) that the tagger can produce when it matches a shingle to a concept. List at least four. Comma-separated.
notes: CONCEPT, SYN, MULTI_SYN, SPELL, PREFIX (also RECOGNIZED_PRODUCT but domain-specific)

prompt: When the tagger looks up a shingle, exact matches get base score 100×pow, but fuzzy matches get only 25×pow. What is 'pow' computed from, and what is its purpose? Two short sentences.
notes: pow = 2^(originalTokenOffset-1); biases tagger toward longer shingle matches

prompt: By convention, the IndexConceptsHandler harvests catalog fields ending in three suffixes. Name them. Comma-separated.
A document in the concept collection has at least 5 main fields. Name them. Comma-separated.
notes: field, token, weight, lang, source (also id and tokenId)

prompt: Is the concept collection rebuilt on every catalog change incrementally, or is it rebuilt periodically (e.g., nightly)? One sentence.
